request: Upgrade rarity (owner, 2026-11-19): every upgrade option has a rarity (common, uncommon, rare) that grows with the upgrade number, rarer steps are bigger (damage, Block and Poise x1/x2/x4), an Element upgrade ADDS a magic packet to the hit instead of replacing it, and the Blacksmith favours physical kinds. The upgrade picker shows each option's rarity (colour) and its exact size.
success: The Blacksmith's Upgrade Card picker lists the owned cards; choosing one shows its options, and each option names its rarity and its exact size (for example '+2 damage'), with the rarity chip coloured, the before and after faces and the change rows. Nothing overlaps or clips at desktop or phone width and the console stays clean.
failure: An option shows no rarity or no size, prints a raw string, 'undefined' or 'NaN', the chip overflows its option, or the page logs a console error.
